data.text: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I called to You, O Yahweh.
O Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
If You should keep iniquities, O Yah, O Lord, who could stand?
But with You there is forgiveness, That You may be feared.
I hope for Yahweh, my soul does hope, And for His word do I wait.
My soul waits for the Lord More than the watchmen for the morning, The watchmen for the morning.
O Israel, wait for Yahweh; For with Yahweh there is lovingkindness, And with Him is abundant redemption.
And it is He who will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
